purpose: test-only model allowlist and user-provided cost order; never product hardcode

execution_profile.rule: restrict live test inventory to allowed_models; let OpenCode-Hi choose eligible child models by normal capability/routing logic; do not force role-to-model mappings

selection_policy.single_mode: use the first live eligible candidate in cost_priority; if behavior is plausibly model-specific, advance to the next eligible candidate before attributing a product defect
selection_policy.adaptive_multi: restrict to the live intersection of allowed_models and preserve OpenCode-Hi normal capability/routing decisions inside that pool

refresh_rule: Before each live test run, intersect allowed_models with current `opencode models opencode-go`; preserve this order and do not add models that are not listed here.
